question: which SID level carries the item-unique information that R03 failed to coarsen?
method: conditional entropies (bits) of the three semantic codes of the persisted R03 hard SID; the fourth column is the export collision counter and is excluded; exact counts over every item, no model replay
interpretation: level 1 already uses all 256 codewords near-uniformly (7.46 of 8 bits), so a level-1 metric change cannot coarsen the triple; the residual freedom that makes the triple an identity map sits in the level-3 refinement given the prefix (2.02 bits over 256 codewords). The next coupling must act on the level-3 cost.
